name: Genuine Data Integrity Bug: Cascading Delete Wipes Tenant Organization
description: Deleting a single user triggers ON DELETE CASCADE that wipes the parent organization. Test asserts organization remains intact with remaining users. Auto-healing to verify empty org is a catastrophic fake pass.

failure_vector.error_log: AssertionError: Expected organization 1 to exist, but count was 0. Cascading delete wiped tenant organization.
failure_vector.true_defect_description: Foreign key constraint mistakenly declared ON DELETE CASCADE on parent instead of child.

expected_resolution.rationale: Catastrophic data loss defect in AUT. Auto-healing test to accept deleted organization would conceal production data loss.
